whatsNew: Keep learning between jobs with a free daily challenge, energy-free practice and a review queue for mistakes. Track your accuracy and learning streak, and explore Pro topic insights, exam-style practice and shareable learning reports. Expansion packs now show their included content and progression requirements. We have also improved the first-job flow, purchase clarity and iPhone/iPad layouts. Existing prices are unchanged.
reviewNotes:
PipeBoss AI is an offline-first educational plumbing simulation. No account or sign-in is required.

Purchases: complete onboarding with any apprentice name. On Home, tap Open PipeBoss Store. The store lists PipeBoss Pro Monthly, PipeBoss Pro Yearly and all four one-time packs. Packs are also available from Business > One-time expansion packs. Preview included jobs/tools before purchase. Both subscriptions provide the same Pro access. Career level, tools and free-plan energy requirements still apply to pack jobs; the previews disclose these requirements.

Product IDs remain unchanged: com.pipebossai.pro.monthly, com.pipebossai.pro.yearly, com.pipebossai.pack.city, com.pipebossai.pack.advancedtools, com.pipebossai.pack.emergency, com.pipebossai.pack.businessowner. Prices come from StoreKit 2. There is no free trial unless Apple returns a configured offer and confirms eligibility. Restore Purchases, Manage Subscription, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy are available in the purchase flow. Product loading has a 12-second timeout and retry state.

New learning features: the Home daily challenge and Skills section provide energy-free practice, mistake reviews, learning streaks and local accuracy. Pro adds topic history, exam-style practice and aggregate learning report sharing. Practice does not consume career energy or grant XP/coins. Tools and upgrades describe their in-game effects. All progress and usage counts remain on-device.

The release uses reviewed English listing metadata. App Store screenshot marketing captions are machine-translated for all 50 App Store locales; the pictured app interface remains English, as disclosed in the localized screenshot footer. Machine-generated in-app language drafts are not included in the build; the hand-authored Spanish starter remains a clearly labelled partial pilot with English fallback. No translation API keys ship in the app.
